errors.description: The dataset's definition does not hold against the catalog: its sources, joins, references or expressions.
The source is not complete: its tenant column is not declared or a string column is not reviewed.
The request is not a valid change of the source: its id, columns or values.
A Wow source's value is only tightened: a lower protection takes a privileged reviewer's approval.
An aggregate of the catalog's sources already takes the dataset's name.
The dataset was never published.
No publication of the dataset awaits an approver.
The source's table is no longer in the warehouse.
The warehouse has no such table in the configured databases.
A reference names an aggregate the catalog does not know.
The warehouse did not create the dataset version's view.
The table is a Wow table, described by its trusted wow_catalog row: not an analyst's to draft or revise.
The request carries no valid credentials.
The caller may not send this command.
The aggregate is outside the caller's scope.
The command body cannot be read as the command type.
The command failed validation; the problem lists the violations.
The wait is not a chain the runtime can follow; the command was not run.
The aggregate does not handle this command.
The aggregate does not exist.
The aggregate already exists.
The aggregate is not at the expected version (412 when the request carried If-Match).
The request id was used by another command.
Concurrent writers kept winning the version; retrying with the same request id is safe.
The aggregate is deleted; only RestoreAggregate applies.
The command was not taken: its aggregate has too many commands waiting, or the node too many in flight; retry later.
Whether the command committed is unknown; retrying with the same request id is safe.
The command's handling failed with an unexpected error; it committed nothing, and a retry fails alike.
The node is shutting down; retry on another node.
A store could not be reached or did not answer in time; retry later, a command with the same request id.
A scheduled command arrived too long before its due time on this node's clock; it is sent again later.
The job command does not fit its job or instance: an unknown job, another scope, or an instance not enabled.
A subscription on the wait chain parked the aggregate; the wait cannot be reached until it resumes.
The wait ran out of time; the command may have committed. The problem carries the last stage reached.
The query body cannot be read as a query.
The query failed admission; the problem lists the violations, each with its code (UNKNOWN_FIELD, ...).
The query backend failed to run the query.
A single query matched no record: a query result, not a statement that an aggregate does not exist.
No dataset of that name is served to the caller.
The query ran longer than its budget allows; narrow it rather than run it again (decision D254 ③).
The query was not run: its store has as many queries running as it allows; retry later.
The dataset is served but cannot be queried now, for the reason the problem names (it needs revision).
The calling service may not call this command: its wow.http.services.<service>.commands do not list it.
